description: Fetches stock quote data from Bloomberg.com quote pages. Note: Bloomberg uses PerimeterX anti-bot protection that blocks most automated access. The skill attempts both HTTP and browser-based fetching with detailed error reporting.

function.description:
Function to call. Available options:
  - get_quote: Fetch a single stock quote by ticker symbol
  - get_quotes: Fetch multiple stock quotes by ticker symbols
  - check_access: Check if Bloomberg.com is accessible

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., 'ZBIO:US', 'AAPL:US', 'MSFT:US'). Used by get_quote.

tickers.description: List of ticker symbols for batch fetching. Used by get_quotes.

method.description: Fetch method - 'auto' (try HTTP first, then browser), 'http' (direct HTTP request), or 'browser' (Playwright with anti-detection). Default is 'auto'.
